response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong web/full-stack background, but the profile does not align with the core requirements of this role. There is no evidence of native-level Japanese proficiency (a hard requirement), no Linux kernel analysis or source modification experience, and essentially no exposure to LAN-switch firmware, L2/L3 networking, MACsec, 802.1X, or chip-vendor SDKs. C experience is limited to a brief stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, with recent work almost entirely in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. Meeting only the general '3+ years of software development' bar while missing multiple mandatory qualifications makes this a poor fit.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop and some embedded/hardware work
Demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput systems work and strong testing/CI/CD discipline
Some prior C/C++ exposure (NI LabWindows/CVI, Linux/JACK audio project) and Linux familiarity
concerns: No indication of Japanese language ability, which is a hard requirement
No Linux kernel investigation/modification or embedded networking firmware experience
No security-protocol (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal) or L2/L3 switching background

key_factors.factor: No embedded/switch networking or security-protocol experience
Dated and limited C/Linux-kernel depth vs. broad senior engineering track record
